reason: R5.1 gave domain-only120 target updates but shared/randomized60. Negative gains and absent primary superiority do not justify a transfer claim; matching target exposure is a defensible separately approved diagnostic.
architecture: Unchanged6967-parameter V5 graph model. Domain-qualified adapters and heads; same initialized shared-core tensors across conditions. No specialist routing counted as transfer.

data.family: Existing R5.1 deterministic register/AST-edit/impulse task grammar with new identities; exact manifests and scorer hashes must be committed before the single qualification screen, after approval.
data.generation_policy: One deterministic draw. No historical task reuse, no favorable filtering or regeneration. Composition labels remain unopened until one final evaluation. Current integration has generated none of these tasks.

conditions.domain_only: Same one-model graph architecture. Every target step updates its encoder,shared core,target head. On auxiliary steps temporarily set core parameters requires_grad=False while preserving differentiation through core operations into auxiliary encoders. Auxiliary encoders/heads update; core gradients are None and optimizer must not update core parameters or moments. Re-enable core gradients on target slots. This is isolated target learning with matched auxiliary compute.
conditions.shared: Same target steps and auxiliary schedule, with core gradients enabled for all domains.
conditions.randomized_auxiliary: Same as shared but a single committed within-auxiliary-domain label permutation, applied only to training effects/validity pairs. No seed/permutation search.

matching: Identical target minibatch identities/order,initial states,learning rate,loss,available observations and final-checkpoint rule across conditions. Persist per-step core/encoder/head gradient and optimizer-state change receipts; no auxiliary-slot core update in domain-only. Full optimizer/source/data freeze required before training.
metrics: Original changed-entity,whole-graph,unchanged-entity,invalid-action and validity metrics; masks only in loss/scorer,never inference. Independent task denominators and other-domain regression reported. No qualification/composition targets in optimization.
stop: No execution under integration authorization. After separate human approval, first freeze full task/scorer/loss/optimizer specification. One qualification screen only; any failed gate means DATA_NO_GO and stop without training. On passing qualification request explicit training approval unless that subsequent authorization explicitly includes it. One final checkpoint per fit; no retries,extra fits,hyperparameter searches or posthoc threshold changes. Success could only support GO_TO_CONFIRMATION.
